question: When dried raisins are placed in a concentrated salt solution, they ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**shrink.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Osmosis**

 
 
• **When they are placed in water, the water from the surrounding diffuses into the raisins and so the raisins swell up. **

 
 
• **​****This process is called osmosis.**
 
 
 
• **When dried raisins are placed in a concentrated salt solution, they will shrink.** **Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
 
• A raisin, when put in a salt solution (or any other concentrated solution), loses water by exosmosis and consequently shrinks.
 
• This happens due to osmosis.
 
• **It is the passage of water from a region of high water concentration to a region of lower water concentration**
